title: Workspace Lambda GitHub Tooling Optimization v1
goal: Minimize the model-visible ChatGPT/GitHub orchestration delay and interaction between a naturally required Lambda workflow becoming terminal and ChatGPT validating its compact exact-SHA evidence and beginning the next substantive owning-task action, while treating the execution-policy/P5 runtime as externally authoritative.
acceptance_criteria: The execution-policy/P5 task remains authoritative for workload choice, security boundaries, exact-SHA admission, required validation/acceptance evidence, host/runtime policy, trusted-cache policy, runner cleanup, and CPU/GPU/model workload decisions.
Optimization measurements count only assistant-visible GitHub connector/tool invocations; hidden REST/API requests inside a connector are not estimated.
Human relay is counted only when the user actually performs terminal, SSH, sudo, or credential work for the measured run.
Missing timestamps/facts remain null rather than being inferred.

Ordinary successful P5 CPU/gpu-small runs bind the exact request through workload + PR number + exact request SHA using existing job identity, then require compact receipt verification before acceptance.
Ordinary successful runs perform zero full-log reads unless terminal status or the compact receipt is insufficient or indicates failure.
Ordinary successful runs require zero routine human terminal/SSH/sudo/credential relay.
Required acceptance/recovery/cleanup evidence mandated by the owning task is explicitly classified and never optimized away merely because it adds reads or latency.
Terminal successful evidence is consumed immediately: terminal status -> compact receipt validation -> next substantive owning-task action with minimum model-visible delay.
No optimization implementation mutates or duplicates execution-policy/P5/runtime responsibilities.
constraints: Observer/optimizer role only: do not mutate, reinterpret, weaken, or duplicate execution-policy/P5 workload, security, admission, validation, host/runtime, cache, cleanup, or workload-class policy.

Consume CONTROL_LOOP_OBSERVATION_V1 records only from naturally required successful CPU/gpu-small runs; do not request extra runs, probes, SSH sessions, logs, artifacts, or validation solely for measurement.
Count one GitHub read per assistant-visible connector/tool invocation used for run binding, status, job detail, logs, or artifact retrieval; ignore hidden connector-internal requests.
Preserve null for facts/timestamps not naturally observed.
Treat owning-task-required acceptance/recovery evidence as required evidence, not orchestration inefficiency.
Do not use run.head_sha as issue-comment candidate identity.
Prefer exact existing job identity plus compact receipt evidence over success-path full logs.

Keep proposed tooling changes owned by this child task and limited to connector sequencing, correlation ergonomics, compact evidence discovery, redundant-read elimination, human-relay reduction, and terminal-evidence handoff.
Do not modify research-engine workflows merely to collect optimization telemetry.
